tips.text: Buy the Dragon Nikana blueprint from the Market; only the base Nikana needs a clan with the Tenno Lab.
Pick up the last Argon Crystal on the day you start the Dragon Nikana build, since stock halves at daily reset.
Keep logging in; Daily Tribute can occasionally hand out the finished Dragon Nikana.
Expect one short Void session for Argon plus two 12-hour builds; nobody finds the rest painful.
Build it for the Mastery; players call it decent but outclassed by newer Nikanas.
